name: http
description: The http source accepts HTTP requests on a configurable port and converts them into Data Prepper events.

port.description: The port number on which the HTTP source runs. Default is 2021.

path.description: The HTTP path on which the source receives requests. Default is /log/ingest.

ssl.description: Enables SSL/TLS encryption. When enabled, requires SSL certificate configuration.

ssl_certificate_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file. Required when ssl is true.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file. Required when ssl is true.
